issues.message: Clone fidelity: the page carries 72% of the source page's words (needs 85%). Restore the source's own text verbatim — do not paraphrase.

headings: the adson beckman retractor is a premium-grade, self-retaining surgical instrument engineered for deep tissue retraction during spinal, neurosurgical, and orthopaedic operations. built with dual-hinged shanks, it offers maximum flexibility and enhanced view in deep or hard-to-reach surgical sites.
we provide a 1-year servicing guarantee covering any operational issues during the warranty period. returns are also accepted for any manufacturing defects.
